authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 135 aṅguli explicitly gives Bengali āṅul/āṅguli finger. The anatomical finger gloss selects this stem rather than 134 aṅgula, a finger-breadth measure. Exact survey form aŋuli is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

assignments.Notes: CDIAL 135 aṅguli explicitly gives Bengali āṅul/āṅguli finger. The anatomical finger gloss selects this stem rather than 134 aṅgula, a finger-breadth measure. Exact survey form aŋuli is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10991 *laṣṭi gives Nepali lāṭho and Hindi/Bhojpuri lāṭhī stick, alongside MIA laṭṭhi. The survey laṭ(h)i/laṭṭhi forms fit the stick family; the remote lakuṭa/yaṣṭi crossing remains tentative. Exact survey form laṭʰi is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
